findings.first_frame: 5.6s is effectively a black frame (only a faint back silhouette, no light). Moved in-point to 6.0s where a thin vertical light sliver plus the silhouette make the scene readable on the cut.
findings.motion: 6.0-6.6 sliver widens, 6.6-7.8 curtains swing open and warm light floods over hands/shoulders, 7.8-9.2 arms spread holding curtains. Continuous motion through the whole 3.2s.
findings.faces: Back of head only for the entire clip; face never turns toward camera in 0-16s.
findings.acting: Natural curtain pull, no camera acknowledgement. The exaggerated arm-stretch begins at ~11.5s and is outside the used range; do not extend the cut past ~9.5s.
findings.tone: Low-saturation brown/white, natural light. Weakness: window clips to pure white from ~8.0s (hard digital blowout, not soft film halation). Recommend a mild highlight roll-off or a short dissolve out around 9.0-9.2s.
findings.framing: Third-person back view, not POV, no bed/blanket. Accepted because the tone sheet allows back views and no POV hand-on-curtain clip exists in the library.

alternates_verdict.3977: Rejected as primary: defocused warm glow through sheer curtain, essentially zero movement over 3.4s and no hand/curtain action. Keep only as a possible dissolve/texture layer.
alternates_verdict.22240: Rejected: cold grey overcast light, urban skyline, dark silhouette; 0.4-1.2s frames are near-black. Clashes with the warm morning tone.
